performing-ui-repository-archaeology.ownership: Own artifact-level, snapshot-bound repository archaeology and decide whether source evidence is deep enough to authorize downstream material consideration.

synthesizing-cross-source-ui-language.ownership: Own layer authority and conflict resolution when multiple external UI sources influence one local product language.

auditing-ui-research-depth.ownership: Independently falsify shallow/citation-theater research and decide PASS versus research-more/reselect/block on evidence depth.

benchmarking-ui-skill-effect.ownership: Own controlled causal evaluation of whether UI skills and skill interactions measurably change target behavior.

routing-to-ui-authorities.ownership: Own decision-dimensional external authority routing, including primary/corroborating selection, applicability limits, currentness, and authority-conflict resolution.

compiling-concrete-design-packets.ownership: Own conversion of abstract task obligations plus resolved authorities into a bounded, source-bound, immediately executable set of design decisions and blockers.

adapting-institutional-design-knowledge.ownership: Own transfer of mature institutional patterns into local context without treating accumulated upstream practice as universal or erasing local research requirements.

orchestrating-implementation-authorities.ownership: Own layer-by-layer selection and orchestration of semantic, visual, platform, motion, and specialist implementation authorities while preserving local product ownership.

validating-rendered-perception.ownership: Own evidence that the agent actually inspected rendered UI across material viewports, states, typography, signature, surfaces, and temporal behavior before aesthetic completion claims.

designing-domain-native-signatures.ownership: Own the transformation of subject-world artifacts, operations, quantities, and metaphors into product-specific visual or interactive signatures without copying external trade dress.

building-agent-readable-ui-context.ownership: Own live, compact, provenance-preserving context adapters for MCP, llms.txt, agent skills, structured docs, and open code without confusing access protocol with authority.

compressing-ui-decisions-for-execution.ownership: Own loss-minimized compression of routed UI decisions into an executable brief with hard obligations, rationale handles, ambiguity budgets, and explicit re-expansion triggers.

exporting-nui-to-agent-harnesses.ownership: Own loss-minimized, permission-preserving exposure of canonical NUI to vendor agent skill roots, MCP hosts and generic CLI callers without duplicating the knowledge graph.

governing-external-agent-skills.ownership: Own supply-chain trust decisions for third-party agent skills, including immutable snapshot, rights, executable capability envelope, instruction/data boundary and bounded adoption mode.

mapping-visual-media-opportunities.ownership: Own the decision of where subject-native photographs, illustrations, diagrams, archival material, video, 3D or generated media carry more product meaning than generic interface geometry.

sourcing-rights-safe-visual-media.ownership: Own discovery and asset-level rights/provenance verification for external visual media; public discoverability never substitutes for reuse permission.

authoring-domain-native-visual-assets.ownership: Own the conception and creation brief for custom imagery/illustration/3D/data-art assets whose visual grammar emerges from subject truth rather than generic AI/SaaS motifs.

orchestrating-creative-toolchains.ownership: Own stage-by-stage routing across image generation, design canvas, vector/raster editing, 3D, animation and browser rendering tools while keeping semantic and rights authority outside the tools themselves.

replacing-shape-substitution.ownership: Own detection and removal of unjustified abstract cards, orbs, blobs, fake graphs and geometric stand-ins when stronger subject-native visual evidence exists.

validating-visual-asset-integration.ownership: Own rendered evidence that selected/generated media survives composition, crop, responsive states, contrast, performance, accessibility and rights checks inside the actual product UI.
